summary.ja: 保存則の各界面を局所Riemann問題として扱う有限体積の基準法。公開例は区分一定の空間再構成に近似流束とSSPRK3を組み合わせ、Sod問題で高次法との差を比較する。
summary.en: A finite-volume baseline using a local Riemann problem at each interface. The released example combines piecewise-constant spatial reconstruction, an approximate flux and SSPRK3, enabling comparison with higher-order solvers on Sod's problem.

code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Godunov (1959). A difference method for numerical calculation of discontinuous solutions of the equations of hydrodynamics.
references.scope: Original Godunov-method source. It is not evidence that the local SSPRK3/approximate-flux implementation reproduces the original fully discrete algorithm.

supports.ja: Godunov法の原報。今回確認したのは原誌の書誌であり、局所実装の時間積分・近似流束を原報と同一とは扱わない。
supports.en: Original paper for the Godunov method; its journal record was checked. The atlas uses a separately specified time integrator and approximate flux.

verification.locator: Journal archive bibliographic record; Russian full text not reviewed.

references.label: Shu & Osher (1988). Efficient implementation of essentially non-oscillatory shock-capturing schemes.
references.scope: Primary source for TVD Runge–Kutta time discretization and flux-based ENO construction; the local SSPRK(3,3) coefficients are independently visible in code.

supports.ja: 流束ベースの構成とTVD Runge–Kutta時間離散化に関する一次文献。ここで用いる3段3次の係数は公開コードで確認した。
supports.en: Primary source for TVD Runge–Kutta time discretization and flux-based construction. The atlas three-stage third-order coefficients were checked in code.

verification.locator: Publisher-indexed abstract and bibliographic record; full tableau not reviewed.

references.label: Toro, Spruce & Speares (1994). Restoration of the contact surface in the HLL-Riemann solver.
references.scope: Original HLLC contact-restoration source; no claim that all wave-speed estimates or WAF experiments in the paper are implemented.

supports.ja: HLL近似解へ接触波を復元する考え方の原報。論文中の各波速推定やWAF計算をすべて再現したという意味ではない。
supports.en: Primary source for restoring the contact wave missing from HLL. Its complete wave-speed alternatives and WAF experiments were not audited.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record; full text not reviewed.

references.label: Sod (1978). A survey of several finite difference methods for systems of nonlinear hyperbolic conservation laws.
references.scope: Historical shock-tube comparison used as a benchmark source. The atlas reference is its own non-vacuum ideal-gas Riemann evaluator, with a bracketed numerical pressure solve.

supports.ja: Sod衝撃波管という比較課題の出典。参照値は本サイトの非真空・理想気体Riemann解評価器で求め、論文表を転記した値とは区別する。
supports.en: Benchmark provenance for the Sod shock tube. Atlas reference values come from its non-vacuum ideal-gas Riemann evaluator, rather than transcribed paper tables.

verification.locator: Publisher-indexed abstract and bibliographic record; detailed initial-state tables not reviewed.

assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional hyperbolic conservation laws on a uniform Cartesian grid with a model-compatible numerical flux.
Euler assumes a perfect gas and positive density/pressure; HLLC and other Euler fluxes are available. Shallow-water and isothermal models require HLL or Rusanov in this solver.
solve(...,method='godunov') sets reconstruction slopes to zero and advances with SSPRK(3,3). Initial data are sampled at grid locations and used as cell values.
The released solver requires 0<CFL≤0.5; this bound alone is not a positivity guarantee for arbitrary inputs.
units: Use units consistent with each model's conserved variables and fluxes. Euler uses density ρ, momentum density ρu and total energy density E; each flux has its conserved-variable unit times length/time. Released shock tubes are nondimensional.
boundary_conditions: The released _pad supplies periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states, or edge extrapolation. Extrapolation is not an exact nonreflecting condition; reflecting walls and general inflow conditions are not implemented. Boundary fluxes contribute to global balances on nonperiodic domains.

limitations.ja: 空間1次なので衝撃波や接触面が広がる。原報の厳密Riemann解を用いる1段更新そのものではなく、時間3次でも全体の空間精度は1次のまま。近似流束・初期値の点サンプル・境界処理の選択に依存し、真空、乾湿境界、一般EOS、多次元および一般的な正値性・エントロピー保証は対象外。
limitations.en: First-order spatial reconstruction smears shocks and contacts. This is not the original one-step exact-Riemann algorithm, and third-order time stepping does not raise its spatial order. Results depend on the approximate flux, sampled initialization and boundary treatment. Vacuum, wet/dry fronts, general equations of state, multiple dimensions, and general positivity/entropy guarantees are outside scope.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 対象は1次元・一様Cartesian格子上の双曲型保存則で、各方程式に整合する流束を選ぶ。
Eulerでは理想気体、正の密度・圧力を前提とし、HLLC等を選べる。浅水・等温モデルにはHLLまたはRusanovを選ぶ。
公開solve(...,method='godunov')は傾きを0にし、SSPRK(3,3)で時間積分する。初期値は格子点でのサンプルをセル値として与える。
公開solverが受け付けるCFLは0<CFL≤0.5。この上限だけで任意の入力の正値性を保証するものではない。
units_ja: 方程式ごとの保存変数と流束に一貫した単位を使う。Eulerでは密度ρ、運動量密度ρu、全エネルギー密度Eで、流束の単位は各保存量×長さ/時間。公開衝撃波管は無次元。
boundary_conditions_ja: 公開_padは周期、端点初期値固定、または端値の外挿でゴースト値を作る。外挿は厳密な無反射条件ではなく、反射壁や一般の流入条件は実装していない。非周期領域の総量変化には境界流束が入る。

problem.ja: 圧縮性流体など、衝撃波を含む1次元保存則の時間発展。
problem.en: Time evolution of one-dimensional conservation laws, including shocks in compressible flow.

variant.ja: solvers.solveのmethod='godunov': 区分一定状態＋選択した近似Riemann流束＋SSPRK(3,3)。既定Euler流束はHLLC。
variant.en: method='godunov' in solvers.solve: piecewise-constant states, a selected approximate Riemann flux and SSPRK(3,3). HLLC is the default Euler flux.

ja: 高次再構成の効果を測る、保守的な空間1次の比較基準が欲しい。
実装範囲内の1次元モデルで、波速に応じた時間刻みを選べる。
en: A conservative first-order spatial baseline is needed to measure the effect of higher-order reconstruction.
A supported one-dimensional model can be stepped according to its wave speeds.

ja: 接触面や滑らかな波を少ないセルで高精度に保ちたい。
真空・乾燥・複雑な境界を、この基準solverだけで保証付きに扱いたい。
en: Contacts or smooth waves must remain highly accurate on a coarse mesh.
Vacuum, dry states or complex boundaries require guarantees absent from this baseline solver.

reason.ja: solveの再構成分岐、対応モデル、CFL検査を確認。
reason.en: Inspected reconstruction branches, model restrictions and CFL checks in solve.

reason.ja: equations.pyの保存変数・物理流束で定義。
reason.en: Specified from conserved variables and physical fluxes in equations.py.

reason.ja: 空間再構成と時間積分を分け、原法との差を明記。
reason.en: Distinguishes spatial reconstruction, time integration and the historical algorithm.

summary.ja: solvers.pyのsolve・rk3・_pad、equations.pyのEuler/Barotropic、riemann.pyの近似流束とexact_eulerを読んだ。test_sod_accuracy_and_refinementのgodunov分岐と参照Riemann値のテストを確認。実行や原論文の数値表の再現はしていない。
summary.en: Read solve, rk3 and _pad in solvers.py, Euler/Barotropic in equations.py, and the approximate-flux and exact_euler functions in riemann.py. Inspected the Godunov branch of test_sod_accuracy_and_refinement and reference-Riemann tests. No tests were rerun and no paper tables reproduced.

ja: Godunov原報のロシア語本文、原法との逐式比較。
新しい再実行、全流束・全モデルでの収束証明、真空・乾湿境界。
en: Russian full text and equation-by-equation comparison with the original Godunov method.
New numerical runs, convergence proofs for every flux/model combination, vacuum or wet/dry fronts.
